description: One recurring charge (utility/service/fee) on a lease. The facility is a Link to Charge Type, so new facilities are new rows in that taxonomy, never new columns. Fixed shows by default; Metered reveals the meter fields. allow_on_submit lets a charge be added/stopped mid-term without touching rent.

fields.description: Fixed method: the per-PERIOD amount (e.g. 200 / month internet).
fields.label: Amount / Period

fields.description: Advance = bill at period start (like rent). Arrears = bill after the service period (utilities; Metered is always Arrears).
fields.label: Timing

fields.description: Accounting dimension for this charge's invoice line. Blank = property-level.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: Optional: start billing this charge from this date (defaults to the lease start).
fields.label: Charge Start

fields.description: Optional: stop billing this charge after this date (defaults to the lease end).
fields.label: Charge End

fields.description: Revenue account for this charge's invoice line. Else the Charge Type's Service Item income account; else the settings default.
fields.label: Revenue Account

fields.description: VAT template override. Else resolved from the lease's contract type, like rent.
fields.label: Tax Template

fields.description: Defaults from the unit's electricity/water meter where available.
fields.label: Meter No

fields.description: Rolling latest meter reading; seeds period 1 and is advanced by each captured Meter Reading.
fields.label: Previous Reading

fields.description: Price per metered unit (e.g. per kWh / m3).
fields.label: Tariff / Unit

name: Lease Charge
